properties.heading: Only the shape of the day matters for a store
properties.text: A store that must deliver the same heat each day buys the same total energy whatever the prices are. So the level of a price forecast cannot change the schedule: adding 100 SEK/MWh to every hour, or scaling the whole day, leaves the chosen hours identical. What changes the answer is the order and the relative size of the hours - which is what this model is built to get right, and what it is measured on.

properties.heading: A fuller tank is worth more than a lower average error
properties.text: The schedule is decided once, before the day starts, and the tank can only hold so much. Being close on average matters less than being right about which hours to fill in - an error that moves the cheapest hours costs money even when the average is good.
